content:
Platforms: iOS
An event that indicates an Obj-C method has been tampered with. MethodSignature indicates which Obj-C method has been tampered with. ImageFileName
contains the path to the image containing the new, swizzled, implementation of the method. ExpectedImageFileName contains the path where it was expected.
SuspectAddress contains the load address of ImageFileName. ExpectedAddress contains the load address of ExpectedImageFileName.
